customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as env vars in CI workflows. The github-actions manager only looks at `uses:` lines, so these were updated by nobody -- five of them are still on whatever version they were written with. Annotate a variable with a `# renovate:` comment above it and it gets picked up here.

packageRules.description: A human gate for images this repo runs as stateful apps. Renovate can and does automerge these -- it shipped immich v3.2.2 straight to production on 2026-09-27, unreviewed -- and that is what this rule stops. Automerge stays on for Docker Hub images, whose blast radius is smaller here. minimumReleaseAge is dropped rather than kept: the soak exists to let other people hit a regression before a robot merges it, but once a human decides the timing the soak only delays the notification, and a PR nobody has seen yet is not a risk. Must stay AFTER the matchUpdateTypes rules above -- packageRules are applied in order, last match wins.
